coach_says: Your anaerobic load is well over target (1039 vs 837 max) while both aerobic buckets are in range, and with TSB at -11.5 and moderate readiness, this week concentrates all intensity into your committed Tuesday double and keeps everything else firmly aerobic. Friday and Sunday get the long Zone 2 work in the best weather windows, with Wednesday locked in as pure recovery. Watch morning HRV after Tuesday — if it drops sharply, downgrade Thursday's gym session to yoga and push it to Saturday.

days.details: Total: 60 min | Objective: aerobic maintenance, fresh legs for Tuesday | Zone 2, RPE 3-4. Outdoor road ride before work — clear skies and light wind make this a great morning. Steady conversational pace throughout, high cadence (90+ rpm), no surges, no sprints. Flat or rolling route. This is deliberately easy: tomorrow is your only hard day of the week.

days.session: Double: Hills AM + Hard MTB Group PM
days.details: AM (60 min): Hills road ride | Objective: sustained climbing strength | Warm up 15 min Z2, then ride the climbs at Zone 3-4 (RPE 6-7) seated where possible — sustained tempo/threshold rather than punchy attacks, since your anaerobic load is already over target. Descend and recover between climbs, cool down 10 min Z1. PM (90 min): Hard MTB group ride — committed session, ride as it comes. Fuel well between sessions (carbs at lunch, eat within 30 min of finishing the evening ride) and prioritise sleep tonight.

45 min gentle recovery flow. Focus: hips, hip flexors, glutes, lower back and thoracic spine — everything Tuesday's double loaded up. Long holds (60-90s), deep breathing, nothing strenuous. No riding today regardless of how you feel. Windy outside anyway — nothing missed.

Lunch gym session, 45 min. Warm-up: 8 min — bike erg easy spin, glute bridges 2x12, band walks 2x10 each way. Main: Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (moderate load, controlled tempo), Single-Leg Step-Up 3x8 each leg (moderate dumbbells), Hip Thrust 3x10, Single-Leg Calf Raise 2x12 each, Pallof Press 3x10 each side, Side Plank 3x30s each side. Rest 90s between main lifts, 60s on core work. Objective: posterior chain strength and single-leg stability at moderate load — deliberately no heavy quad-dominant work (no back squats today) with tomorrow's long ride ahead. Leave 2-3 reps in reserve on every set.

Total: 3 hr | Objective: aerobic base volume | Zone 2 throughout, RPE 3-4. Clear conditions — take the road bike on a rolling route. Steady discipline: keep power/HR capped in Z2 even on climbs (shift down, spin up). No intervals — your aerobic-low bucket does the work here. Fuel 60-80g carbs/hr and drink to thirst. If you feel flat from Tuesday, cut to 2 hr rather than pushing intensity up.

Windy day (32 km/h) — pool day. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle mixed with 100m drill (catch-up or fingertip drag). Main set: 6x100m freestyle at steady aerobic effort (RPE 5), 20s rest between reps. Cooldown: 100m very easy choice of stroke. Total: 1000m. Focus on long strokes and relaxed breathing — this is active recovery for the legs, light work for the upper body. Optional: 30-45 min easy walk later in the day if you want to move.

days.session: Long Endurance Ride with Tempo Blocks
days.details: Total: 3.5 hr | Objective: aerobic endurance with controlled sustained work | Best weather of the week — clear, light wind. Road bike or MTB, your choice for variety. Structure: 45 min Z2 warm-up, then 2x15 min Zone 3 tempo (RPE 5-6, smooth and seated) with 10 min Z2 between blocks, remainder in Z2, final 15 min easy Z1. Tempo blocks add sustained aerobic-high stimulus without touching the anaerobic system — absolutely no sprints or punchy efforts. Fuel 60-80g carbs/hr. If legs feel heavy in the first hour, skip the tempo blocks and ride pure Z2.
